signature: SUBROUTINE DSYSWAPR( UPLO, N, A, LDA, I1, I2)

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N matrix A. On exit, the permuted matrix where the rows `I1` and `I2` and columns `I1` and `I2` are interchanged. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the interchanges are applied to the upper triangular part and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced; if `UPLO = 'L'`, the interchanges are applied to the lower triangular part and the part of A above the diagonal is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: i1
params.reference: Index of the first row to swap

params.name: i2
params.reference: Index of the second row to swap
